acceptanceRules: Inspect the map image and margin before assigning a date or scale.
Confirm that the clean Kunming crop is actually covered.
Georeference independently and record control points and residuals.
Keep each dated geometry as a separate version.
Do not use 1:1,000,000 or smaller-scale maps for detailed shorelines.
Cross-check accepted geometry against DEM topology and modern OSM without silently snapping it.
